howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: Our system uses advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze your agricultural data and provide accurate crop recommendations.

step1.title: Data Collection
step1.description: We collect soil and climate parameters including N, P, K levels, pH, temperature, humidity, and rainfall data.

step2.title: ML Processing
step2.description: Our machine learning models (Decision Tree, SVM, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes) analyze the input data.

step3.title: Pattern Matching
step3.description: The system compares your data against 2200+ historical agricultural records to identify optimal crops.

step4.title: Smart Recommendation
step4.description: You receive a ranked list of suitable crops with match scores to make informed farming decisions.

rice-blast.name: Rice Blast
symptoms: Gray-green lesions turning white with brown borders
Neck rot causing the panicle to break
treatment: Apply fungicides like Tricyclazole or Isoprothiolane
Remove and destroy infected plant debris
Apply silicon-based fertilizers to strengthen cell walls
Use copper-based fungicides as a preventive measure

bacterial-leaf-blight.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight
symptoms: Leaves dry up from the tip downward
causes: Wounds from insects or mechanical damage
treatment: Apply potassium fertilizers to strengthen plants

maize-rust.name: Common Rust of Maize
symptoms: Small circular to elongated brown pustules on leaves
Pustules appear on both leaf surfaces
Premature leaf death in severe cases
treatment: Apply fungicides like Mancozeb or Propiconazole
Remove infected plant debris after harvest
Apply foliar fungicides at the first sign of infection
Use triazole-based fungicides for severe infection
prevention: Early planting to avoid peak infection periods

cotton-wilt.name: Fusarium Wilt of Cotton
treatment: No effective chemical treatment once infected
Solarize soil to reduce pathogen levels
Apply biological control agents like Trichoderma

mango-anthracnose.name: Mango Anthracnose
symptoms: Black spots on flowers and young fruits
Sunken dark lesions on mature fruits
treatment: Hot water treatment of harvested fruits (52°C for 5 min)
Prune and destroy infected plant parts
prevention: Ensure good air circulation through pruning

banana-sigatoka.name: Black Sigatoka
symptoms: Small pale streaks on lower leaf surface
causes: Dense plantings with poor air circulation
prevention: Remove old leaves to improve airflow

citrus-canker.name: Citrus Canker
symptoms: Raised corky lesions on leaves and fruits
causes: Wounds from thorns, insects, or wind
treatment: Remove and destroy infected plant parts

grape-powdery-mildew.name: Powdery Mildew of Grape
symptoms: White powdery growth on leaves and shoots

chickpea-wilt.name: Chickpea Wilt
symptoms: Rapid wilting of the entire plant
Brown discolouration of roots and stem base
causes: Previous chickpea cultivation in the field

papaya-ringspot.name: Papaya Ringspot Virus
symptoms: Oily streaks on stems and petioles
treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately
Use reflective mulches to repel aphids

coffee-leaf-rust.name: Coffee Leaf Rust
symptoms: Orange-yellow powdery spots on leaf undersides
Pale yellow spots visible on upper leaf surface
treatment: Remove and destroy fallen infected leaves
Apply fungicides preventively during the rainy season
prevention: Balanced fertilization to maintain plant vigour

pomegranate-bacterial-blight.name: Bacterial Blight of Pomegranate
symptoms: Dark brown to black lesions on fruits
